_about: The For you tab (/next/directory/#foryou, opened from the landing page): what the landing page's AI read in someone's words (topics, place, preferences, safety: build/tools/assist/tags.json) turned into picks and buttons by the rules here. No AI here. Read by build/next/js/for-you.js. topics: for each topic, its line, the service types that make a good first step, words in a name or description that make one better (prefer_words), the groups (who) it suits (groups_ok) and a short name for buttons. open_to_all: the who values that mean anyone can go: the picks only use services open to all (or to a group the topic suits, groups_ok), since we don't know who's asking. score: each candidate gets days until it next runs + miles x per_mile, plus a penalty for each way it fits less well (other_area: a service in another area; check_first: one restricted to people we can't tell they are; exact_words: less when it has their own words for an activity; activity_on_the_side: more, for an activity, when the service isn't one of activity_types (a breakfast drop-in with a sing-along, rather than a singing group); not_weekly: more for something that meets less than weekly, so a weekly group beats a monthly one that happens to be today; in_name: less again when the activity or their words are in its name, so it's what the group is for); the lowest wins. roles, main_lines and restrictions: what each pick is for, the established lines for each topic and area, and who a service is only for (each has its own _about). help_types: the kinds of help someone can ask for, as the sheet's types. when_hours: what daytime and evenings mean (a session's start time) and which days are weekends. safety: the panel for each risk group (most serious first), its words and the services (sheet record ids) it shows, with more by topic or for under-18s; picks: whether the usual picks show beneath (none, or relevant: only their topics, nothing added). explore: the buttons beside the picks; kind_titles: a button's title for each kind of service.

heading: A few places to start
intro: Based on what you've shared, here are some options that might help. You can explore them in any order.
no_place: Choose a town to see places near you. For now, here are some you can phone or use online.

lines.gap_anywhere: We couldn't find {what}, so here's somewhere to meet people
lines.relaxed: Nothing nearby at the times you said, so this is the soonest
lines.activity_related: We couldn't find {what} near {place}, but this has {activity}
lines.online: {line}, online at the times you said

none: We couldn't find a good match for that. Try the tabs above, or talk to someone straight away using the helplines below.

also: Showing places near {place}. You also mentioned {also}:

roles._about: For each topic, what its picks are for, in order (each topic takes its first role, then the next topic its first, and so on, up to max_picks). place: the best in-person service for the topic (by phone or online if they'd rather, or there's no place); line: the next of the topic's main lines (main_lines) for their area, then national ones; any topic not here: place, place.

main_lines._about: The established phone and online services for each topic, by the person's area (Somerset when we don't know it), then national (a national one can come first in an area's own list): sheet record ids, tried in order. Each is still checked against the live record (there, no notice, open to them) and never two from one provider. why: the reason they're here, for whoever maintains this.

low mood.why: NHS talking therapy (self-referral) and the area's listening line

anxiety.why: NHS talking therapy, the area's listening line, then the national anxiety line

bereavement.why: Cruse, the national bereavement charity; the area's bereavement line; practical help after a death

finances.why: the area's Citizens Advice line, then the national debt charities

housing.why: the council's housing and homelessness line, then Shelter

caring for someone.why: the area's carers' service, then Carers UK

dementia.why: the area's dementia support line, then Alzheimer's Society's national line

addiction.why: the area's drug and alcohol service, then the national gambling line

eating disorders.why: Beat, the national eating disorder charity

restrictions._about: Who a service is only for (the sheet's restricted_to). area: an area restriction and the area it means: fine when it's their area (from their town; Somerset when we don't know), otherwise never picked. with_topic: fine when they asked about one of these topics (a carer asking about dementia can go to a memory café). check: we can't tell, so it can be picked, after open ones, with this line under it. Anything else (veterans, sight loss, other and so on): never picked, since we don't know who's asking; the directory still shows it. GP practice beside an area value is just the area. who_check: a group (the sheet's who) we can't tell they're in, picked after open ones with this line. who_words: a group they named in their own words for an activity (a men's shed), so it can be picked.

check.GP practice: For patients of some GP practices: check with them
